tools.name: search_games
tools.description: Resolve one or more game names to their Steam appids on needmoar.games. Call this first to turn a title like "Hollow Knight" into the numeric appid the versus and game_detail tools need. Accepts several names at once — pass every game the user mentioned in a single call and match each to its result.

queries.description: Game names to look up. Pass every title the user mentioned at once.

items.description: A game name to resolve, e.g. "Hollow Knight".

limit.description: Max matches to return per name (1-10, default 5).

tools.name: versus
tools.description: Head-to-head verdict for two games on needmoar.games: which one players like more, each game's community score (the share of a library it beats) and rank, and the full distribution of opinions on both. Use this to answer "do people prefer A or B?". Pass Steam appids — resolve names with search_games first. The response links to the matching /vs page you can cite.

appid_a.description: Steam appid of the first game (resolve names with search_games).

appid_b.description: Steam appid of the second game.

tools.name: game_detail
tools.description: The community consensus for one game on needmoar.games: how liked it is (the share of a typical library it beats), its tier and rank, the full distribution of opinions, and the games players who like it also like or dislike — useful for "how popular / well-liked is X?" and "games similar to X". Also, in the players' own words, what they liked about it and what kept them from ranking it higher (short tags with counts), once enough players said so. Pass a Steam appid — resolve names with search_games first. The response links to the game's page you can cite.

appid.description: Steam appid of the game (resolve names with search_games).
